review_basis: YouTube identity via oEmbed plus the previously retained full timestamped caption transcript, independently compared with the new Gemini audiovisual extraction.

checks.caption_observation: The instructor contrasts evenly spread cylinder quads with a slid edge loop and limits the warning primarily to curved surfaces.
The instructor selects the planar region and uses an inset to create a loop that follows the complete boundary before checking the highlight.
The instructor demonstrates terminating added density away from the corner, rejects an inward-folding diamond, and eases polygon size from small to medium to large.

limitations: The in-app browser control kernel failed and direct YouTube frame extraction was blocked by anti-bot authentication, so this independent check uses retained captions rather than new screenshots.
Caption agreement verifies spoken demonstrations, not every fine visual topology detail. Blender reproduction remains the visual test.
